strengths: GIL correctly released in ALL methods
Score normalization + threshold filtering in search() — correct (unlike letta)
Metadata stored as JSON via serde_json (preserves structure, unlike openai/ollama flat string)
AtomicU64 key generation — no UUID dependency
weaknesses: clear() only deletes first page — data loss over 100 records
Metadata non-string values silently dropped BEFORE JSON serialization
serde_json dependency unique among adapters — unnecessary
Test coverage thin (5 tests, no error paths)
Post-GIL threshold filtering fetches unnecessary results
comparison: Middle of the pack. Better than openai/ollama/litellm (correct score normalization, metadata serialization). Weaker than mem0/letta (RwLock dead overhead, serde_json dependency). clear() pagination bug is the real issue.
